evidence.quote: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now offers significantly higher default shard limits for data streams in Provisioned capacity mode, increasing from 500 to 20,000 shards per AWS account in the US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), and Europe (Ireland) regions.

evidence.heading: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams increases default shard limits to up to 20,000 per AWS account

evidence.quote: With the increased limits, customers using Provisioned mode can now process up to 10 GB/sec of ingress and 20 GB/sec of egress per account by default, and they can always request further increases to this limit.
